name: Sunfeast Farmlite Digestive High Fibre
ingredients_raw: Maida (Refined Wheat Flour) (39.2%), Refined Palm Oil, Wheat Flour (Atta) (18.4%), Sugar, Wheat Bran (4.3%), Liquid Glucose, Raising Agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii), INS 450(i)], Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Iodized Salt, Emulsifiers [Lecithin (from Soyabean), Diacetyltartaric and Fatty Acid Esters of Glycerol (from Sunflower Oil & Palm Oil), Mono - & Di - Glycerides of Fatty Acids (from Palm Oil)], Malt Extract, Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Wheat Fibre (0.03%), Flour Treatment Agent (INS 223) and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla).
